answers.core:
Godot may provide the wheels for a Signal Bus, but expects everyone to be their own mechanic and build one yourself.

It would be nice if beginners could not have to worry about that for a while and just hop on a train. ;)
answers.workaround:
First off, this is mainly an editor enhancement, precisely because one shouldn't have to use a few lines of script for this (and even if one does, there should be a way to visualize those few lines in the Editor, which there currently isn't).

Second, most discussions I've seen online inevitably leads to an experienced Godot user recommending a beginner Godot user to implement a Signal Bus, which is way more than a few lines of script.

title: Show nodes in groups when connecting signals in the editor
